name: Summit AZ - F2 Trenchless Posts Changes 2026-09-18
body:
> Blog · Summit Az · 2026-09-18

# Summary
Exact change list ("F2") to stop the two trenchless blog posts from competing with each other and with the service pages: post 10122 `/blog/trenchless-pipe-lining/` ("How It Works") and post 10138 `/blog/trenchless-sewer-repair-mesa-az/` (the Arizona guide).

# Key findings (GSC Jun 17 to Sep 16)
- "trenchless" queries site-wide: 1,090 impressions, 0 clicks, average position 49.7.
- The two blog posts hold the worst positions (63.5 and 54.7) yet take the largest share of impressions, while service pages already rank 7 to 26 for trenchless terms.
- Post 10138's top queries are generic, not Mesa, and 4 of its 5 FAQs duplicate post 10122's FAQs.
- Link gap: 10122 did not link /pipe-lining-phoenix/ or /pipe-lining-mesa/.

# Proposed role split
- 10122 = the plain explainer (definition, 5-stage process, benefits, suitability).
- 10138 = the decision guide (lining vs bursting, Mesa candidacy, signs), giving up its duplicated CIPP walkthrough and FAQs.

# Changes
- F2-1, F2-2 (low risk): add Phoenix and Mesa pipe lining links; point the bursting question at the Mesa guide.
- F2-4 to F2-6: condense the duplicated CIPP list, replace 4 duplicated FAQs with Mesa questions, add a Phoenix lining link.
- F2-7: split the focus keywords between the posts.
- F2-8 (optional): retitle 10138 to show the Mesa focus.

# Decisions and status
- Per the change log, F2-1, F2-2 and F2-4 to F2-7 were applied Sep 18 (Kim approved). F2-8 was held for Kim.
- Oct 1: the focus keyword of 10138 was changed to "trenchless sewer repair" so it stops competing with service pages.
